findings.title: Apache APISIX jwt-auth Algorithm Confusion CVE-2026-39999 (CVSS 9.8) — Pre-Auth Full Auth Bypass on One of the Top-3 Open-Source API Gateways; Public Technical Writeup + Fix in 3.16.1
findings.affected_technology: Apache APISIX jwt-auth plugin (versions v2.2 through v3.16.0)
findings.summary: APISIX trusts server-side key selection but honours the JWT header alg on verify; attacker flips alg to HS256 and signs a token with the RSA public key as HMAC secret, impersonating any consumer unauth — fixed 3.16.1, advisory + writeup 2026-07-04.

findings.title: iCagenda Joomla Extension CVE-2026-48939 (CVSS 10.0) Pre-Auth File Upload → RCE Weaponised With Same-Day GitHub Mass-Exploitation Framework and In-the-Wild 'icagenda-batch/1.0' Scanner
findings.summary: Unauth file upload on the frontend Submit-an-Event form uploads a PHP webshell to a predictable web-served folder; mySites.guru reports in-the-wild scanner tagging User-Agent 'icagenda-batch/1.0', shinthink published mass-exploitation framework to GitHub 2026-07-06 — patched in 4.0.8 (2026-06-15).

findings.title: Apache Camel 2026-07-05 Batch — 25+ Coordinated Advisories via oss-security Covering Header Injection, Infinispan Deserialization, and JMS ObjectMessage RCE Paths
findings.summary: Andrea Cosentino posted a coordinated 25+ Camel advisory batch covering HTTP/CoAP/DNS header injection to header-sensitive producers, Infinispan-cache deserialization gadgets, and JMS ObjectMessage RCE — fixes in 4.14.6 / 4.18.2 / 4.19.0.

findings.title: Microsoft Exchange CVE-2026-45504 (CVSS 8.8) SSRF-via-WOPI Arbitrary File Read — HawkTrace Public Technical Writeup + Working PoC Published Weaponising June 9 Patch Gap
findings.summary: Authenticated low-priv mailbox user creates EWS ReferenceAttachment with crafted ProviderEndpointUrl; SSRF returns file:///path# and the URI-fragment trick makes Exchange read arbitrary local files via FileWebRequest — patched June 9, weaponised PoC + writeup by HawkTrace early July 2026.
